newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-FTSE to trade narrowly between 4,625-4,660.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-FTSE to trade narrowly between 4,625-4,660.

text.p: It will be difficult for the FTSE 100 index to make much headway on Thursday owing to chart resistance at 4,660, technical analysts said.
The index could slip back to about 4,625 and then flatten out, they said.

The market has been erratic this week, heading in one direction and then just as suddenly making an about turn. This may indicate that the correction phase since June 13, when the FTSE closed at 4,783, is drawing to a close but a final outburst needs to be made before more settled conditions appear.
By 0722 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 0.7 points at 4,640.7.
Short-term technical indicators -- which currently suggest the FTSE is oversold -- have the chance to give positive divergence signals if the market keeps sliding.
But it may be a few weeks before the FTSE and its short-term indicators align themselves sufficiently well and a strong buy signal is made, analysts said.
In the meantime, during the current unsettled phase of the market, investors will be more selective in which shares they buy or sell so there remains the potential for big price swings.
